verses.1: In this freedom, Christ has set us free. Therefore, let us also refuse to be slaves again.
verses.2: Look, Paul, I say to you, if Christ has been pleased by you, then nothing will be of any use to you.
verses.3: I again declare to everyone that it is obligatory to obey all laws.
verses.4: You were condemned by Christ, because you were granted justice according to the law; but you lost that grace.
verses.5: For we will, by the spirit of faith, accept hope for justice.
verses.6: For in Christ Jesus, neither circumcision nor baptism matters; what matters is faith, which is activated by love.
verses.7: Keep going well. Who has stopped you from believing in the truth?
verses.8: The deception does not come from trying to persuade you.
verses.9: A small amount of glue makes the entire mixture sticky.
verses.10: I hope that you will consider this carefully. But those who provoke you will surely face punishment, if they do so.
verses.11: But I, brothers, if I still proclaim the resurrection, why should I still seek it? Then the “snake” of the cross will be destroyed.
verses.12: And those who are stirred up among you will also be punished.
verses.13: For you, brothers, have been chosen for freedom. But only not to use that freedom for selfish purposes; rather, you should serve each other out of love.
verses.14: For every law, its provisions are fulfilled through one single principle: Love your neighbor as yourself.
verses.15: And if you try to touch each other and get close to each other, then remember not to get too close to one another.
verses.16: I say, you move around like spirits, and your flesh’s desires never cease.
verses.17: For the flesh desires things according to the spirit, and the spirit, in turn, desires things according to the flesh. This is how they complement each other, so that you can do what you desire.
verses.18: But if you’re carried by the Spirit, then it isn’t subject to law.
verses.19: It’s clear that the actions of the flesh are nothing but prostitution, impurity, and corruption.
verses.20: Sacrilege, witchcraft, hatred, envy, greed, anger, hypocrisy, dualism, prejudice.
verses.21: Enmity, strife, and all things of this kind—things that I say to you—are things that those who do such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.22: And the fruit of the spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, and faithfulness.
verses.23: It’s acceptable; according to such rules, there’s no law in this regard.
verses.24: But those who were crucified with Christ also suffered all kinds of pains and desires.
verses.25: If we live as spirits, then we will also be composed of spirits.
verses.26: Let us not become arrogant and cause each other to suffer. Let us not be envious of one another.
